about: Korean notices for the CS7375 machine-translation study: proposed main set plus backups. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line (\n\n). Image paths are relative to this file. key_question.choices are the multiple-choice options shown to participants (shuffled, plus an "I'm not sure" option); key = which reading the option reflects: "correct" (the true meaning of the Korean) or "flawed" (what the flawed translation implies).

documents.korean:
이 약은 항생제인 아목시실린입니다. 오늘부터 이 주 동안 아침, 점심, 저녁 식사 후에 한 알씩 드세요. 증상이 좋아지더라도 정해진 기간 동안 빠짐없이 드셔야 합니다.

설사가 심하거나 두드러기가 나면 복용을 멈추고 바로 병원에 연락하세요. 약을 드시는 동안에는 물을 충분히 드세요. 약은 햇빛이 들지 않는 서늘한 곳에 보관하세요. 아목시실린은 페니실린 계열이므로, 페니실린 알레르기가 있으신 분은 복용하기 전에 꼭 약사에게 말씀해 주세요.

english.correct:
This medicine is amoxicillin, an antibiotic. Starting today, take one capsule after breakfast, lunch, and dinner for two weeks. Even if your symptoms improve, keep taking it without missing a dose for the full period.

If you develop severe diarrhea or hives, stop taking it and contact your doctor right away. Drink plenty of water while you are taking the medicine. Store the medicine in a cool place out of direct sunlight. Amoxicillin is a type of penicillin, so if you are allergic to penicillin, be sure to tell the pharmacist before taking it.
english.flawed:
This medicine is amoxicillin, an antibiotic. Starting today, take one capsule after breakfast, lunch, and dinner for one week. Even if your symptoms improve, keep taking it without missing a dose for the full period.

If you develop severe diarrhea or hives, stop taking it and contact your doctor right away. Drink plenty of water while you are taking the medicine. Store the medicine in a cool place out of direct sunlight. Amoxicillin is a type of penicillin, so if you are allergic to penicillin, be sure to tell the pharmacist before taking it.

error.correct_span: after breakfast, lunch, and dinner for two weeks
error.flawed_span: after breakfast, lunch, and dinner for one week

documents.scenario: A clinic in Busan prescribed this for an infection. You start it on a Monday and feel better by Friday.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, should you still be taking it on the following Wednesday?
key_question.answer: Yes. The course lasts two weeks.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: No. The flawed translation says the course is one week.

choices.label: Yes, I should keep taking it

documents.korean:
이 약은 콧물과 재채기, 가려움을 줄여 주는 알레르기약 세티리진입니다. 하루 한 번, 자기 전에 한 알씩 물과 함께 드세요. 졸릴 수 있으니 복용 후에는 운전을 피하세요.

복용 중에는 술이나 수면제, 감기약을 함께 드시지 마세요. 복용하는 동안 입이 마를 수 있습니다. 증상이 심해지거나 일주일이 지나도 나아지지 않으면 병원에 가세요. 약은 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하세요.

english.correct:
This medicine is cetirizine, an allergy medicine that relieves a runny nose, sneezing, and itching. Take one tablet with water once a day, before bed. It may make you drowsy, so avoid driving after taking it.

While taking this medicine, do not drink alcohol or take sleeping pills or cold medicines with it. Your mouth may feel dry while you are taking it. If your symptoms get worse or do not improve after a week, see a doctor. Keep the medicine out of the reach of children.
english.flawed:
This medicine is cetirizine, an allergy medicine that relieves a runny nose, sneezing, and itching. Take one tablet with water once a day, before bed. It may make you drowsy, so avoid driving after taking it.

While taking this medicine, do not drink alcohol or take sleeping pills with it. Your mouth may feel dry while you are taking it. If your symptoms get worse or do not improve after a week, see a doctor. Keep the medicine out of the reach of children.

error.correct_span: do not drink alcohol or take sleeping pills or cold medicines with it.
error.flawed_span: do not drink alcohol or take sleeping pills with it.

documents.scenario: You have hay fever and picked this up at a pharmacy. You've also caught a cold and bought cold medicine at a convenience store.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, should you avoid taking the cold medicine together with this one?
key_question.answer: Yes. Cold medicines are on the list of things not to take with it.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: No warning: the flawed translation lists only alcohol and sleeping pills.

choices.label: Yes, I should avoid taking them together
No, they can be taken together

documents.korean:
체크인은 오후 세 시부터, 체크아웃은 오전 열한 시까지입니다. 수영장에 들어가시기 전에 꼭 샤워를 해 주세요. 수영장은 사 층에 있으며, 오전 일곱 시부터 밤 아홉 시까지 이용하실 수 있습니다. 조식은 삼 층 식당에서 오전 일곱 시부터 열 시까지 제공됩니다.

객실 열쇠는 체크아웃하실 때 일 층 프런트에 반납해 주세요. 와이파이 비밀번호는 객실 책상 위 카드에 적혀 있습니다. 궁금한 점이 있으시면 언제든지 프런트로 전화해 주세요.

english.correct:
Check-in starts at 3 p.m., and check-out is by 11 a.m. Please be sure to shower before entering the pool. The pool is on the fourth floor and is open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Breakfast is served in the third-floor restaurant from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m.

Please return your room key to the front desk on the first floor when you check out. The Wi-Fi password is written on the card on your room's desk. If you have any questions, feel free to call the front desk at any time.
english.flawed:
Check-in starts at 3 p.m., and check-out is by 11 a.m. Please be sure to shower after using the pool. The pool is on the fourth floor and is open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Breakfast is served in the third-floor restaurant from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m.

Please return your room key to the front desk on the first floor when you check out. The Wi-Fi password is written on the card on your room's desk. If you have any questions, feel free to call the front desk at any time.

documents.scenario: You're on vacation at this hotel and have just come down to the pool in your swimsuit. The showers are by the pool entrance, and you haven't used them yet.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, do you need to shower now, or can you shower after your swim?
key_question.answer: Shower now: the notice asks you to shower before entering the pool.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: After your swim: the flawed translation says to shower after using the pool.

documents.korean:
저희 호텔을 찾아 주셔서 감사합니다. 한 객실에는 두 분까지만 숙박하실 수 있습니다. 체크인은 오후 세 시부터, 체크아웃은 오전 열한 시까지입니다.

주차장은 지하 일 층에 있으며, 숙박하시는 동안 무료로 이용하실 수 있습니다. 조식은 일 층 식당에서 오전 일곱 시부터 열 시까지 제공됩니다. 객실 내에서는 금연입니다. 와이파이는 호텔 어디에서나 무료로 이용하실 수 있습니다. 엘리베이터는 로비 왼쪽에 있습니다. 수건이 더 필요하시면 프런트로 전화해 주세요.

english.correct:
Thank you for choosing our hotel. Each room can accommodate only two guests. Check-in starts at 3 p.m., and check-out is by 11 a.m.

Parking is on basement level one and is free for the length of your stay. Breakfast is served in the first-floor restaurant from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m. Smoking is not permitted in the rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The elevators are to the left of the lobby. If you need extra towels, please call the front desk.
english.flawed:
Thank you for choosing our hotel. Each room can accommodate two guests, or three if one is a child. Check-in starts at 3 p.m., and check-out is by 11 a.m.

Parking is on basement level one and is free for the length of your stay. Breakfast is served in the first-floor restaurant from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m. Smoking is not permitted in the rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The elevators are to the left of the lobby. If you need extra towels, please call the front desk.

error.correct_span: Each room can accommodate only two guests.
error.flawed_span: Each room can accommodate two guests, or three if one is a child.

documents.scenario: You are booking one room at this hotel for yourself, your partner, and your seven-year-old child.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, can all three of you stay in one room?
key_question.answer: No. Each room is limited to two guests.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: Yes. The flawed translation allows a third guest if one is a child.

choices.label: No, only two guests are allowed per room
Yes, a child can stay as the third guest

documents.korean:
이 약은 이부프로펜으로, 두통과 근육통을 줄여 주고 열을 내려 줍니다. 한 번에 한 알씩, 하루 세 번, 식후 삼십 분에 드세요. 약은 물 한 컵과 함께 삼키시고, 씹거나 부수지 마세요.

복용 중에는 술을 드시지 마세요. 속이 쓰리거나 변이 검게 나오면 복용을 멈추고 병원에 연락하세요. 사흘이 지나도 열이 내리지 않으면 다시 진료를 받으세요. 약은 실온에 보관하세요.

english.correct:
This medicine is ibuprofen, which relieves headaches and muscle pain and brings down fever. Take one tablet per dose, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water; do not chew or crush it.

Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. If you get heartburn or your stools turn black, stop taking it and contact your doctor. If your fever has not gone down after three days, see a doctor again. Store the medicine at room temperature.
english.flawed:
This medicine is ibuprofen, which relieves headaches and muscle pain and brings down fever. Take one tablet per dose, three times a day, 30 minutes before meals. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water; do not chew or crush it.

Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. If you get heartburn or your stools turn black, stop taking it and contact your doctor. If your fever has not gone down after three days, see a doctor again. Store the medicine at room temperature.

documents.scenario: You bought this medicine at a pharmacy in Seoul for a bad headache. It's morning, you haven't eaten yet, and you plan to have breakfast in about half an hour.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, should you take a tablet now, or wait until after you eat?
key_question.answer: Wait until after you eat: take it 30 minutes after a meal.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: Take it now: the flawed translation says 30 minutes before meals.

documents.korean:
저희 게스트하우스를 예약해 주셔서 감사합니다. 체크인은 오후 네 시부터 밤 열 시까지 가능합니다. 예약을 미리 하셨더라도 신분증을 제시하지 않으시면 체크인하실 수 없습니다.

공용 주방은 오전 여덟 시부터 밤 열한 시까지 이용하실 수 있으며, 사용하신 그릇은 직접 씻어 주세요. 밤 열한 시 이후에는 다른 손님들을 위해 조용히 해 주세요. 수건은 이틀에 한 번 바꿔 드립니다. 와이파이 비밀번호는 거실 게시판에 붙어 있습니다. 짐 보관은 체크아웃 당일 오후 여섯 시까지 무료입니다.

english.correct:
Thank you for booking our guesthouse. Check-in is available from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m. Even if you have booked in advance, you cannot check in without showing identification.

The shared kitchen is open from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.; please wash your own dishes after using them. After 11 p.m., please keep quiet for the other guests. Towels are changed once every two days. The Wi-Fi password is posted on the board in the lounge. Luggage storage is free until 6 p.m. on your check-out day.
english.flawed:
Thank you for booking our guesthouse. Check-in is available from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m. If you have booked in advance, you can check in without showing identification.

The shared kitchen is open from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.; please wash your own dishes after using them. After 11 p.m., please keep quiet for the other guests. Towels are changed once every two days. The Wi-Fi password is posted on the board in the lounge. Luggage storage is free until 6 p.m. on your check-out day.

error.korean_span: 신분증을 제시하지 않으시면 체크인하실 수 없습니다
error.correct_span: Even if you have booked in advance, you cannot check in without showing identification.
error.flawed_span: If you have booked in advance, you can check in without showing identification.

documents.scenario: You booked this guesthouse online weeks ago. When you arrive, you realize your passport and ID are in a bag you left at a friend's place.

key_question.question: Based on everything you've seen, can you check in without ID?
key_question.answer: No. You cannot check in without ID, even with a booking.
key_question.answer_if_trusting_flawed: Yes. The flawed translation says a booking lets you check in without ID.

choices.label: No, I can't check in without ID
